body_markdown:
Pony.ai has been made aware of fraudulent websites and Telegram accounts using the Pony.ai name, official images, video footage and company information without authorization. Some of these websites use domain names containing “aiponyhk.”


The operators of these websites and accounts have set up purported “investment bots” and “customer service” accounts, falsely claiming to offer investment opportunities connected with Pony.ai. They promise high returns and ask individuals to transfer Bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies.


These websites, accounts and investment offers are fraudulent. They are not operated, endorsed or authorized by Pony.ai and have no connection with the company.


For the avoidance of doubt:


- Pony.ai does not offer investment or wealth management products or services, solicit funds from the public, or conduct cryptocurrency transactions.
- Pony.ai has not authorized any individual or third party to offer investments, raise funds or conduct cryptocurrency transactions on its behalf.
- Pony.ai does not conduct business or contact users for commercial purposes through Telegram.


Information from Pony.ai should be verified through the following official channels:


- Website:[www.pony.ai](https://www.pony.ai/?ref=blog.pony.ai)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/pony-ai/
- X: https://twitter.com/PonyAI_tech


Do not respond to unsolicited investment offers claiming to be from Pony.ai, transfer funds, or disclose personal or financial information. Be particularly cautious of any offer promising unusually high or guaranteed returns.


Pony.ai has reported the matter to the police and relevant regulatory authorities. We demand that those responsible immediately stop using the Pony.ai name, identity and materials. Pony.ai will pursue all available legal remedies against anyone involved in these activities.


If you encounter a suspected scam involving Pony.ai or someone claiming to represent the company, you may emaillegal@pony.ai to verify or report it. If you believe you have been targeted or have suffered a financial loss, please report the matter promptly to your local law enforcement authorities.


Pony AI Inc.


October 14, 2026
